decision: APPROVED EXACT BOUNDED KEYBOARD DELIVERY DOCUMENTATION
scope: Independent review of eight final documentation/skill files and three retained images against the combined acceptance record, source review, contracts and native evidence.
findings: The Focused default wording is now correctly limited to GUI-added and MCP Start virtual pairs in supported automatic or concurrent assigned routing. Legacy profiles and new fixed-relative GUI pairs keep Clicked; generated clones inherit their source settings.

Recipient query counts/fallbacks, same-PID/root/owned-popup candidate scope, clicked-target GUI-thread reads, no foreground lookup or focus activation, and candidate-versus-delivery limits match the contract and source review.

Raw-key disablement precedes recording, Escape handling and keyboard replication; mouse-to-key output and saved key-up cleanup remain available. Settings changes cancel queued keyboard paths and release held owners before commit.
The MCP settings/state path and 23-tool/no-new-grant claims are accurate. Stable-seat GUI synchronization preserves a locally edited draft when external acknowledged settings arrive.

Native evidence is correctly bounded to owned x64 targets and the custom focus-preserving fixture. Dynamic application focus, Tab behavior under the pinned backend, physical devices and native fixed-relative behavior remain unverified.

The minimum tail is described as an off-draft checkbox and Apply visible before Apply, followed by an acknowledged settings result. Recipient modes require ordinary scrolling; simultaneous checkbox-plus-mode visibility remains explicitly unproven and excluded.

The 320x360 minimum image shows only the checkbox/footer claim; the 540x520 images match the reviewed focused and external-draft states. All three published PNGs are byte-identical to the approved source originals.

Producer and native counts, x64 execution versus i686 build-only scope, preserved failed/pending raw verdicts, and open full Ultra/UX parity match the combined acceptance record. The combined record hash matches the published assessment reference.
limits: No arbitrary-application, hardware, desktop-wide, same-process isolation, full keyboard accessibility, full compact visual parity, full Ultra or full UX claim is approved.
The corrected documents/skill are approved for the bounded scope; broader behavior still requires separate evidence.
